message:
Discharge trigger: route the patient to the recovery dashboard on discharge

When the Update-medical-files flow processes a document (the photo/PDF discharge
letter), the patient is marked discharged and the running-picture screen forwards
to the recovery dashboard.

- apps/mobile/app/lib/dischargeState.ts (new): in-memory discharge flag mirroring
  liveSession.ts — setDischarged()/isDischarged()/clearDischarge() + the single
  RECOVERY_ROUTE constant ("/recovery").
- upload.tsx: setDischarged(true) in showMerged() (live extract) and useSample()
  (sample discharge summary).
- session.tsx: `if (isDischarged()) return <Redirect href={RECOVERY_ROUTE} />` —
  flash-free forward whenever discharged; the recording -> /session path is untouched.

Note for Schmidt (recovery dashboard frontend): this is the trigger that brings the
patient to your dashboard. Build the dashboard at RECOVERY_ROUTE ("/recovery" ->
apps/mobile/app/recovery.tsx today), or repoint that one constant in
app/lib/dischargeState.ts to your route. On discharge the app already navigates here
(the <Redirect> in session.tsx). When we add tab-sliding between the running picture
and your dashboard, keep isDischarged() as the signal and swap the <Redirect> for
selecting your tab.
